subject: Redwood x CloudWave Demo - finalize time & runbook
messages:
From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudwave.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@acmesys.com>, Stephanie Liu <stephanie@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 15:23:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x CloudWave partner demo — proposed windows

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the intro. CloudWave + Acme Systems are excited to get a joint demo on the calendar (marketplace listing + SI integration walkthrough). We have a few presenter constraints next week and wanted to propose two windows:

- Tue Apr 13, 14:00–15:00 PDT / 21:00–22:00 UTC (best for CloudWave APAC-engaged PM)
- Wed Apr 14, 09:00–10:00 PDT / 16:00–17:00 UTC (best for CloudWave EMEA attendees)

Agenda idea: 60 minutes total — 10m intros, 30m demo (end-to-end: Redwood API -> CloudWave connector -> SI deployment), 15m Q&A, 5m next steps. We can do a 30-min tech-rehearsal 24–48 hours prior if that helps.

Can you confirm which slot works for Redwood and whether Acme can make either? Also, who should own the runbook/slide deck? Happy to own the connector demo slides.

Cheers,
Alex
Account Exec, CloudWave
[Attachment: cloudwave-integration-one-pager.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@acmesys.com>, Stephanie Liu <stephanie@amazon.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudWave partner demo — proposed windows

Alex — thanks, that sounds good. Either slot is workable for Redwood but we prefer the Wed Apr 14 09:00–10:00 PDT window to keep our US and EMEA teams aligned (we can rotate APAC rehearse times).

Quick asks before we lock:
- Can Acme confirm an engineer + a solutions lead for the demo? Ideally a single engineer who can SSH into the SI staging environment for a quick live check.
- We’ll propose a 30-min tech-rehearsal on Tue Apr 13 at 10:00 PDT — is that okay?
- I’ll attach our runbook draft and send a calendar invite once everyone confirms.

Looping in Ben and Karthik to confirm staffing and any infra constraints (especially around GPU-backed inference on the dedicated env).

Thanks — Tessa
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | partner@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@acmesys.com>, Stephanie Liu <stephanie@amazon.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudWave partner demo — proposed windows

On Tue, Apr 6, 2027 at 9:10 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks, that sounds good. Either slot is workable for Redwood but we prefer the Wed Apr 14 09:00–10:00 PDT window...

Confirming Redwood can staff the Wed 9–10am PDT slot. Ben (me) will own partner intros and customer success handoff. Tessa — for the live demo we should avoid heavy synthetic load on dedicated pools; Karthik, can we provision a small pre-warmed instance in staging for the demo (N=1 GPU)? If not, we fallback to a recorded clip for the 30s high-throughput section.

Action items:
- Karthik: provisioning check (staging GPU)
- Tessa: send runbook + calendar invite once Acme confirms engineers
- Alex/Priya: confirm who will present the connector and who will own the SI deployment steps

Ben
Sr. Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudwave.io>, Priya Rao <priya@acmesys.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood x CloudWave partner demo — provisioning + runbook

Ben / Tessa — provisioning is OK. I reserved a single p4-like instance in the staging pool for Wed Apr 14 08:30–11:00 PDT so we have time for rehearsal and a quick warmup. I attached the latest runbook (minor edits) — please review owners and timings.

Key notes in runbook_v2.pdf:
- 08:30–09:00 PDT — tech rehearsal (Redwood infra + Acme engineer confirm connectivity)
- 09:00–09:10 PDT — intros & agenda (Ben)
- 09:10–09:40 PDT — live demo (Alex + Priya present connector + SI deployment)
- 09:40–09:55 PDT — Q&A (open)
- 09:55–10:00 PDT — next steps & handoff to CS (Tessa/Ben)

Lauren — can you please create the calendar invite and include the runbook link + calendar.ics so CloudWave/Acme can add to their calendars?

[Attachment: runbook_v2.pdf (PDF)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cloudwave.io>, Priya Rao <priya@acmesys.com>, Stephanie Liu <stephanie@amazon.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Wed Apr 14 09:00–10:00 PDT — Redwood x CloudWave demo (calendar invite + runbook)

Thanks everyone — Wed Apr 14 09:00–10:00 PDT is locked. Calendar invite attached (redwood-cloudwave-calendar.ics) and the runbook is attached / linked. Quick checklist for tomorrow:

- REHEARSAL: Tue Apr 13 10:00–10:30 PDT (tech rehearsal, please join 10m early)
- HOSTS: Ben (intros & CS handoff), Alex (connector demo), Priya (SI deployment), Karthik (infra support)
- STAGING: Pre-warmed instance reserved 08:30–11:00 PDT
- ATTACHMENTS: runbook_v2.pdf, calendar.ics, cloudwave-integration-one-pager.pdf (from Alex)

If anything changes I’ll send a short update but otherwise we’ll see you in the rehearsal.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
reduwood.ai | partner@redwood.ai
